name: auv_vulnerable_remus100
description: Real US Navy REMUS-100 shallow-water mine-countermeasures AUV digital twin -- hull/mass/buoyancy/drag sourced from Thor I. Fossen's PythonVehicleSimulator, on a disclosed 6-thruster actuation simplification (see sim_config/models/remus100/model.sdf header -- no ArduPilot firmware supports REMUS-100's real fin-steered control). Out-of-the-box ArduSub config -- no GCS-link hardening. GPS/AIS are structurally N/A submerged (real physics: RF doesn't penetrate water; ArduPilot never consumes AIS on any vehicle). Boot via tools/run_vehicle.sh vehicle_twins/auv_vulnerable_remus100 up.
